diagnosis: The check C1 passed in all rollouts despite PF3 being absent because the model defaulted to investing the full amount, which aligns with the initial draft. This indicates a structural bias towards full investment in the model’s default behavior.

C1.why: Without PF3 the draft invests all $25,000,000, but PF3 changes uninvested_cash_reserve_usd to exactly $7,000,000 and leaves exactly $18,000,000 available for an approvable reinvestment plan.
